description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, which specifies a contract for classes that handle logging output, including the println method for outputting log messages with various levels, tags, and optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system component that outputs logs to one or more targets. Defines a method println for logging messages with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the LogNode to output a log message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
